summary.zh: 应用图标更新:星球轨道图案保留,背景换成单一米白色,并改为标准 macOS 圆角(圆角外透明),桌面与 Dock 显示更干净。
summary.en: App icon refresh: the planet-and-orbit motif stays, the background becomes a single flat ivory, and the icon now uses the standard macOS rounded squircle with transparent corners.

highlights.zh: 图标背景从带暗角和纹理的纸纹底换成纯一色米白(#F6EEEA),四角的暗色晕影和噪点纹理全部去除。
highlights.en: The icon background goes from a vignetted, textured paper fill to one flat ivory (#F6EEEA) — corner darkening and grain are gone.

highlights.zh: 图标改为标准 macOS squircle 圆角(圆角外透明),此前源图是全幅方形、圆角外带着暗角色块;星球、轨道环与星星图案原样保留。
highlights.en: The icon now uses the standard macOS squircle with transparency outside the rounded corners (the previous source was a full-bleed square with darkened corners); planet, ring and sparkles are unchanged.

highlights.zh: build 目录源资产(icon.icns、modelswap-icon-macos.png)同步替换,后续所有构建与自动更新保持新图标。
highlights.en: The build source assets (icon.icns, modelswap-icon-macos.png) are replaced so every future build and auto-update keeps the new icon.
